issue.title: Render Bob-provided short start tokens in the Mac Capture agenda

task_type_fields.proposal: Proposed by bob-cli-a7.3 note #1; independently verified by bob-cli-a7.land on bob-cli a0ac8451 and bob-mac-capture 785508c. Add an optional start_token to selectable named capture-pomodoros agenda entries, composed exclusively by capture_language::named_start_token. CaptureCore should decode it and render it in the Later accessory, falling back to =#slug with older Bob. Update CaptureAgendaView.headerTimeView styling to recognize the rendered start hint, and the empty-state copy to teach =NAME without implementing the eligibility predicate in Swift. Current concrete sources: src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs::CapturePomodorosOutputEntry has no start_token; Sources/CaptureCore/CaptureAgendaPresentation.swift:671 builds =#\(slug), line 311 says =#NAME starts one; Sources/BobMacCapture/CaptureAgendaView.swift:818 styles hasPrefix("=#"). Cover ordinary letter names, digit-led/close-like names retaining #, unavailable/nonselectable entries, and older-Bob fallback. Preserve Bob Mac Capture as a thin client. Use just check in bob-cli, portable-check plus the applicable macOS compile checks from the linked repo AGENTS.md; no just check-full. This is bounded wire/presentation work, size medium.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved plan plan:202610/bare_pomodoro_names.md explicitly requires this Mac hint change to be proposed as a separate follow-up. Existing =# hints remain valid, so it is a presentation extension rather than a regression or missing a7 capture grammar. The derived-home feature bob-cli-9n concerns unnamed labels, not start-token spelling; no semantic duplicate was found in all-status searches or the one-week task sweep.

issue.creation_reason: Triage the explicitly deferred Mac hint proposal from bob-cli-a7.3 note #1 so the new short spelling reaches the agenda without copying Bob grammar into Swift.
